title: Pelican-VLA 0.5: Attending Before Acting Benefits Generalization
summary: Pelican-VLA 0.5 unifies vision-language understanding, future-frame generation, and robot action prediction in one VLA architecture. Its learnable Bottleneck Token sits between perception and action, forcing task-relevant visual information through a compact interface so the policy naturally attends to the object and contact region needed for manipulation, even without masks, object labels, attention supervision, or task-specific fine-tuning. The report shows this attention-level generalization holds in unseen scenes and across unseen robot embodiments, and is stronger than other open-source VLA baselines.

extra.full_text: In this report, we present Pelican-VLA 0.5, a unified VLA model that integrates vision-language understanding, future-frame generation, and action prediction within a single architecture. Pelican-VLA 0.5 achieves attention-level generalization: without object annotations, segmentation masks, attention supervision, or task-specific fine-tuning, its action pathway already focuses on the manipulation-relevant object and contact region. This behavior persists across unseen scenes and unseen robot embodiments, and is substantially stronger than in other open-source VLA baselines. We verify that this ability originates from the learnable Bottleneck Token inserted between perception and action: by routing task-relevant visual information through a compact bottleneck, the tokens interface induces manipulation-centric attention during pre-training and remains effective across different policy structures, including a MoT-style architecture.

title: NEO’s Hands
summary: 1X introduced new 25-DoF hands for its NEO humanoid platform, with fully actuated fingers, palm, thumb, a 3-DoF wrist, closed-loop tendon drive, and high-resolution tactile sensing for in-hand manipulation. The company says the hands can handle everyday dexterous tasks such as assembling LEGO, installing light bulbs, zipping jackets, pouring tea, and using tools, while remaining compliant, waterproof, food-safe, and durable over millions of cycles. Beyond expanding NEO’s physical capabilities, the hands are positioned as a way to collect large-scale real-world manipulation data for training more robust robot world models.

extra.full_text: The new 25-DoF robotic hands for the NEO platform mark a fundamental leap in physical AI. 1X has developed hands that achieve human-level dexterity, strength, safety, and reliability. With 25 fully actuated degrees of freedom in the fingers, palm, and thumb including a 3-DoF wrist, a closed-loop tendon-driven system, and high-resolution tactile sensing, these hands enable true in-hand manipulation and precision interaction across countless everyday tasks– from assembling LEGO and installing light bulbs to zipping jackets, pouring tea, and using tools with human-like adaptability (and infinitely more). Strong yet inherently safe and compliant, IP68 waterproof and food-safe, and built to endure millions of cycles, the new hands don’t just expand NEO’s capabilities. They unlock high-quality, real-world manipulation data at scale, accelerating the training of robust world models and bringing general-purpose autonomy closer than ever. summary: MIT’s FloatForm uses swarms of small aquatic robots that physically latch together on the water, echoing how ants form living rafts. The system points toward floating structures that can assemble, reshape, and potentially adapt in place rather than being built as fixed platforms.

extra.full_text: MIT researchers developed FloatForm, a swarm of small aquatic robots that snap together like ants forming a raft, assembling into reconfigurable structures on the water.

title: 中 1~5월 로봇 수출 1000만대 돌파…수출액 4.5조원 육박
summary: China exported 10.377 million robots in the first five months of the year, worth 19.99 billion yuan, or about 4.44 trillion won, according to customs figures cited by CCTV. The exports reached more than 150 countries, with Europe and Southeast Asia as major markets, and Shanghai alone handled 8.36 billion yuan of shipments, about 40% of the national total.

extra.full_text: 중국의 로봇 수출액이 5개월 만에 4조원을 넘어섰다.로봇 전문 포털 중국로봇망에 따르면 중국 관영 방송 CCTV가 세관 통계를 인용해 올해 로봇 산업 1~5월 수출 대수가 1037만7000대에 달했다고 밝혔다. 수출 총액은 199억9000만위안(약 4조4399억원)이었다.로봇은 세계 150여 개 국가로 판매됐으며, 유럽과 동남아 지역이 핵심 수출 지역이었다. 상하이 항구를 통해 이뤄진 수출액이 83억6000만위안(약 1조8583억원)으로, 전국 총 수출액의 40%를 차지했다는 점도 특징이다.세부적으로 로봇 청소기가 포함돼 있는 청소

title: New flapping robot swims and flies like a diving bird
summary: MIT engineers built a flapping robot that can both fly through air and swim underwater, using a diving-bird-inspired design for aerial-aquatic movement. The result points toward vehicles that could transition between sky and ocean for exploration or monitoring, rather than needing separate platforms for flight and underwater travel.

extra.full_text: MIT engineers’ design could lead to a new class of aerial-aquatic vehicles for ocean exploration.

title: Commercial UAV Expo Debuts DRONERESPONDERS Program Management Course, Unveils Public Safety Summit Program
summary: Commercial UAV Expo is adding a two-day DRONERESPONDERS program management course alongside a Public Safety Summit focused on operational drone use in emergency response. The agenda centers on Drone as First Responder programs, fire service and crash-scene applications, shared-airspace coordination, and counter-UAS lessons from the 2026 FIFA World Cup, reflecting how public-safety drone work is moving from pilots and demonstrations toward managed, multi-agency operations.

extra.full_text: New two-day program manager training joins the Public Safety Summit’s agenda spanning Drone as First Responder, fire service, crash-scene applications, and shared-airspace operations, plus a two-part session on counter-UAS lessons from the 2026 FIFA World Cup
